scripts.licenses:rust: cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && cargo about generate about.hbs --fail -o licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES-rust.txt && node ../../../scripts/to-lf.mjs licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES-rust.txt
scripts.licenses:tools-advisories: cd apps/desktop/src-tauri/tools/perf && cargo deny --manifest-path Cargo.toml --config ../../deny.toml check advisories && cd ../../fuzz && cargo deny --manifest-path Cargo.toml --config ../deny.toml check advisories
scripts.licenses:check: node scripts/npm-licenses.mjs --check && cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && cargo deny check && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('target',{recursive:true})" && cargo about generate about.hbs --fail -o target/notices-rust.txt && node ../../../scripts/to-lf.mjs target/notices-rust.txt && diff -q target/notices-rust.txt licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES-rust.txt
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/check-size.test.mjs scripts/coverage-table.test.mjs scripts/affected/*.test.mjs scripts/a11ylens/*.test.mjs scripts/design/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 exec vitest run --passWithNoTests --coverage && pnpm --filter @cadabracraft/desktop test:e2e:coverage && pnpm coverage:report
scripts.test:coverage:rust: pnpm --filter @cadabracraft/desktop exec cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --lcov --output-path src-tauri/target/llvm-cov.lcov --ignore-filename-regex 'src/main.rs' && pnpm --filter @cadabracraft/desktop exec cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml report --json --output-path src-tauri/target/llvm-cov-summary.json --ignore-filename-regex 'src/main.rs' && pnpm coverage:report:rust
